content.title: ZUMZ Q3 Deep Dive: Margin Expansion and Private Label Growth Drive Upside
content.summary: Clothing and footwear retailer Zumiez (NASDAQ:ZUMZ) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $239.1 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $293.5 million at the midpoint, 2.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.55 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
